description: This file defines the 'DB' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Session' namespace. The class implements session handling by storing session data in a database, including methods for reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting sessions.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Implements session storage management leveraging a database backend with methods for reading, writing, deleting, and garbage collecting sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session database handler with registry objects for database and configuration access.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database for the given session ID, if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database for the specified session ID, with expiration set according to configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data associated with a specific session ID from the database.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired sessions from the database based on a probabilistic trigger.
